detail.title: WAKE Research Cycle 69: Hypothesis Formulation for Reward Scalarization
detail.summary: This cycle proposes a new hypothesis to address the limitations of static reward scalarization identified in the assumption_challenge domain, shifting focus toward testing dynamic weight adjustment as a mechanism for handling non-stationary multi-objective environments.

detail.title: Falsifying Reward Scalarization Assumptions
detail.question: Can the assumption that scalarized rewards accurately represent multi-objective goal hierarchies be falsified in autonomous agents?
